wholePhysicalScope: Mapped Martello tower, enclosing wall, concrete block and Mapzen headland elevations. Two exact original photographs by Man vyi show the surviving stone and concrete profile.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the tower, curving stone enclosure and adjoining block.
limitations: Models the visible main fort core. Outlying ruins, fixtures and interiors are outside scope.
Roof openings, small stonework and the elevation of separate parts are approximate. Mapzen data resolves the broad headland grade.
